title: Finite covering axioms for the transported precoverage
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-covering-construction, the transported precoverage Q has HasIsos, IsStableUnderFiniteComposition, IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange, and HasPullbacks.

proof.text: Apply the four separate transport theorems to the unchanged hypotheses and assemble their conclusions as the four existential witnesses, followed by True.intro. This is a decomposition, not a net proof gain.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YL; decomposition of the four covering axioms, K1, 2026-10-13.

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_site_covering_axioms
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)) :
        ∃ (_ : Q.HasIsos) (_ : Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition)
          (_ : Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange) (_ : Q.HasPullbacks), True
